fields.name: Office of the President
fields.description: The highest executive office responsible for national leadership, state functions, and coordination of government ministries.

fields.name: Office of the Deputy President
fields.description: Supports the President as principal assistant in execution of presidential functions and deputy party leader duties.

fields.name: Office of the Prime Cabinet Secretary
fields.description: Coordinates and supervises government ministries and state departments for efficient service delivery.

fields.name: Ministry of Interior and National Administration
fields.description: Responsible for internal security, national registration, immigration, and coordination of national government administration.

fields.name: Ministry of Defence
fields.description: Oversees the Kenya Defence Forces and is responsible for the defence and protection of Kenya's sovereignty.

fields.name: Ministry of Foreign and Diaspora Affairs
fields.description: Manages Kenya's foreign policy, diplomatic relations, and diaspora affairs worldwide.

fields.name: Ministry of Finance and National Planning
fields.description: Responsible for fiscal policy, budget formulation, public debt management, and national economic planning.

fields.name: Ministry of Health
fields.description: Ensures access to quality healthcare services, public health management, and health policy development.

fields.name: Ministry of Education
fields.description: Oversees all levels of education from early childhood to university and vocational training.

fields.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development
fields.description: Promotes food security, agricultural productivity, livestock development, and farmer empowerment.

fields.name: Ministry of Water, Sanitation and Irrigation
fields.description: Manages water resources, sanitation services, and irrigation infrastructure development.

fields.name: Ministry of Energy and Petroleum
fields.description: Responsible for energy policy, petroleum exploration, renewable energy development, and power generation.

fields.name: Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure
fields.description: Oversees road, rail, maritime, and air transport infrastructure development and maintenance.

fields.name: Ministry of Lands, Public Works, Housing and Urban Development
fields.description: Manages land administration, public works, housing development, and urban planning.

fields.name: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy
fields.description: Promotes ICT development, digital transformation, broadcasting, and telecommunications.

fields.name: Ministry of Trade, Investment and Industry
fields.description: Promotes trade, investment, industrialization, and enterprise development for economic growth.

fields.name: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection
fields.description: Manages labour relations, employment policy, social security, and welfare programs.

fields.name: Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry
fields.description: Protects the environment, mitigates climate change, and manages forest resources.

fields.name: Ministry of Tourism and Wildlife
fields.description: Promotes tourism, conserves wildlife, and develops the hospitality industry.

fields.name: Ministry of Mining, Blue Economy and Maritime Affairs
fields.description: Develops mining sector, harnesses blue economy resources, and manages maritime affairs.

fields.name: Ministry of Sports, Culture and Heritage
fields.description: Promotes sports development, preserves cultural heritage, and celebrates national identity.

fields.name: Ministry of Cooperatives and MSMEs Development
fields.description: Supports cooperative societies and micro, small, and medium enterprise development.

fields.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
fields.description: Empowers youth through skills development, job creation, and sports programs.

fields.name: Ministry of East African Community and Regional Development
fields.description: Coordinates Kenya's participation in the East African Community and regional integration.

fields.name: Ministry of Gender, Culture, The Arts and Heritage
fields.description: Promotes gender equality, cultural expression, and artistic development.

fields.name: Ministry of Public Service, Performance and Delivery Management
fields.description: Oversees public service reforms, performance contracting, and service delivery improvement.
